title: Straightbourne
text:
Github
  

  
  
straightbourne.uk will be my internet home domain after my research is concluded and I return to sanity, seeking new adventures. Links in the page footer will take you to what’s current.

Straightbourne is a portmanteau of two family names.
Straight, from the West Virginia family line that includes Jacob Straight, father of my grandfather’s grandfather’s grandfather, who in October 1786 was killed and scalped for British bounty in Monongalia County, WV by Shawnee.
Bourne is from the London line of my great-grandfather George Alfred Bourne who walked with his barrow to help build Letchworth Garden City, the first of its design, separating industrial from residential spaces in order to improve the quality of life for its citizens. I grew up in Letchworth.

Nick Hood
@straightbourne
